verdicts.quote: Before they join, explain that a seat may be booked automatically if one becomes available while booking is open, and show the applicable booking consequences.

oldest eligible active entry in authority-accepted join order. … one total order per session, including simultaneous joins. … staff queue administration, priority tiers, external notifications, and new payment or penalty policies are outside this request.
any exceptions required by existing holds, eligibility rules, payment, attendance conflicts or staff actions.
verdicts.missing: Whether booking one class ends the member’s waiting entry for an overlapping class, and when that entry is resolved.

verdicts.quote: leave returns the booked state and offers the existing booking cancellation route where available. … If fees, credits, waivers or penalties require consent beyond the ordinary booking flow, affected sessions are unready for enrollment until settled.
verdicts.missing: Whether cancelling an unwanted automatic booking or missing the promoted class counts under the existing late-cancellation or no-show policy.

verdicts.quote: A confirmed cancellation or effective capacity increase that makes seats free while booking is open triggers allocation, even with all members’ screens closed.
verdicts.missing: How soon the authority must process the vacancy after cancellation.

verdicts.quote: A promotion appears in the ordinary booking view. … Open, refresh and reconnect recover from an authorized current read … No separate notification, subscription, or external delivery boundary is required by this default.
Settle up to the smaller of the number of free seats and eligible waiters … The same seat cannot be taken twice. … A commit removes one active claim and gives that same member one confirmed booking.
If a normal booking races for capacity owed to the queue, refuse that booking while the claim is active. … A commit removes one active claim and gives that same member one confirmed booking.
The product owner must resolve any conflict between automatic enrollment and existing charges or obligations.
verdicts.missing: When to take payment for a promoted booking and what a failed payment does to the booking, queue entry and seat.

verdicts.quote: Any maximum queue length and the admission result when it is reached are unresolved.
verdicts.missing: The queue limit and what the member sees when attempting to join at that limit.

verdicts.quote: At the booking cutoff itself closure wins. … The booking owner must establish actual closure, cancellation, reopening and clock semantics on supported clients.
verdicts.missing: Whether the booking cutoff precedes class start and by how much.

verdicts.quote: effective capacity increase that makes seats free while booking is open triggers allocation … An authorized reduction in capacity that takes effect first leaves only the new available capacity for promotions.
At session cancellation or when booking closes, all remaining entries stop qualifying for any future seat. Show the relevant closed or canceled outcome without a booking confirmation.
After a successful join there is one active entry and no confirmed booking. The app keeps the member/session association and a stable ordering fact in authoritative waitlist state.
verdicts.missing: Whether the entry records its join time and whether its current position is stored or derived from the ordering data.

verdicts.quote: A private terminal outcome may remain only as needed to explain the result or reconcile old intents, then is removed under the applicable retention policy.
verdicts.missing: The retention period or concrete deletion deadline for ended entries after class.

verdicts.quote: Other members’ entries, names, contact details, order and outcomes stay off the client, including response payloads and errors.
verdicts.missing: Whether the member sees their own position in line alongside their waitlisted status.

verdicts.missing: Staff queue viewing, manual promotion and removal are outside the specified workflow. The event requirements do not establish a staff-visible history identifying each promoted member and the promotion time.
